definitions.explanation: Having the quality of being sincere and not deceptive. Describes someone who tells the truth.
Used adverbially to preface a candid statement.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{正直|しょうじき}な{人|ひと}です。
{正直|しょうじき}に{言|い}うと、よく{分|わ}かりません。
examples.english: To be honest, I don't really understand.

examples.japanese: {正直|しょうじき}が{一番|いちばん}です。

notes:
{正直|しょうじき} is a na-adjective meaning honest or frank.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {正直|しょうじき}に (honestly, frankly)
- Noun modifier: {正直|しょうじき}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {正直|しょうじき}に{言|い}う (to speak honestly)
- {正直|しょうじき}に{答|こた}える (to answer honestly)
- {正直|しょうじき}なところ (to be frank)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {素直|すなお}: obedient, honest (also implies being compliant)
- {誠実|せいじつ}: sincere, faithful (more about reliability)
- {率直|そっちょく}: frank, candid (direct manner of speaking)
